⛔ Re-timing a plan at constant speed **smooths** it, so `comfort` jumps by orders of magnitude between two arms that differ only in SCHEDULE. Under the per-arm gate that term enters the composite and turns the source stream's own primary from n.s. into SEPARATED — a verdict flip driven by a smoothing artefact, not by planning. The panel-wide gate drops `comfort` for every arm and is used throughout.
